subject: Film & Cinema
title: Christopher Nolan: Time as a Weapon
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Christopher Nolan: Time as a Weapon.

hook.text: Nolan bends time in every film — Memento, Inception, Tenet, Interstellar — and audiences follow.

buildup.text: He insists on practical effects, IMAX cameras, and theatrical releases over streaming.

discovery.text: Nolan proved that complex, cerebral films can also be massive commercial hits.

twist.text: Critics argue his emotional depth doesn't match his intellectual ambition.

climax.text: Oppenheimer won him his first Oscar and silenced the emotional-depth criticism.

punchline.text: He made thinking feel like an action sequence.

quiz.question: What recurring theme runs through Nolan's films?
options: The manipulation and perception of time
